headline: Saws
title: Saws | Shark Rush Starter | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Saws is a stage one Water Aniimo that can swim. Wavebreaker Shark Rush leaps at the target, and during Frenzied Assault it turns into a piercing dash. High-Speed Cut spins and hits every nearby target for twenty energy. Homeland work is Hauling and Water, both level one. At level sixty four a Wave Stone evolves Saws into Whirlbite. Will you evolve your Saws? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Saws guide: a stage 1 Water swimmer with Wavebreaker Shark Rush and High-Speed Cut, plus Hauling and Water Homeland work. Evolves into Whirlbite at level 64 with a Wave Stone. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Saws is always chasing something, mostly because it never learned to stop.
